The message is simple: “Bihar aur UP wale bhaiyon ko bolna chaahunga… I’m back.”
The “Cockroach” identity emerged in 2026 as a satirical youth-protest label and subsequently became associated with protests around examination issues
column2: student grievances and demands for institutional accountability. Recent reporting has documented the continuing activities and public statements of the Cockroach Janata Party/CJP network.

column1: What this particular video establishes is narrower: the speaker is announcing a return and directly addressing people in Bihar and Uttar Pradesh. The clip itself does not establish what specific programme or action is intended next.
That distinction matters. Political videos can be powerful—but credibility comes from separating what is actually said and shown from what we infer from it.
